title.narrative: Strengthening the socioeconomic capacities of families in the areas of agroecology and health in three vulnerable communities in Haiti
Stärkung der sozioökonomischen Kapazitäten von Familien im Bereich Agrarökologie und der Gesundheit in drei vulnerablen Gemeinden in Haiti

description.narrative: Der Projektträger unterestützt mit diesem Projekt die Verbreitung agrarökologischer Landwirtschaft zur Erhöhung von Ernährungssouveränität und Resilienz. With this project, the project holder is supporting the spread of agroecological agriculture to increase food sovereignty and resilience. The project approach aims to strengthen local processes so that expansion can be continued independently through local initiatives and on the basis of the local resources (empirical knowledge, organized groups) built up in recent years. The health sector complements the work. In addition to holding information events and training courses, this project component also builds local expertise and structures.
